notes.title: Star Control and Star Control II are Now Available on Steam!
notes.content:
[h1]Both games are included in “Star Control: The Ur-Quan Masters”[/h1]

[img]https://www.stardock.com/starcontrol/Screenshots/sc12/sc12_ss01.jpg[/img]

Enjoy the first two classic Star Control games as they were originally released! Save humanity from a savage race of aliens called the Ur-Quan hierarchy in Star Control, then save them again - this time within a memorable, vibrant adventure story - in Star Control II.

Star Control was revolutionary for its time and focused primarily on ship-to-ship battle against the computer or another local player. Star Control II is a truly exceptional game of exploration and adventure that has influenced the entire industry. We’re glad to release both of them on Steam to bring it to even more members of the gaming community!

[img]https://www.stardock.com/starcontrol/Screenshots/sc12/sc12_ss02.jpg[/img]

Features
[list]
[*]Play the games that started it all
[*]Immerse yourself in the Star Control story
[*]Explore a vast universe with bizarre aliens, powerful ancient technologies, and mysterious places
[*]Experience pulse-pounding action, side-splitting humor, and hair-raising plot twists
[/list]
[img]https://www.stardock.com/starcontrol/Screenshots/sc12/sc12_ss03.jpg[/img]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/358920

It’s been over 25 years since the first game’s original release and a new Star Control game is finally coming! Star Control: Origins is currently in development and is now available for pre-order. Purchase today for a special discount and future access to the Super Melee beta in late 2017!

Pre-order Star Control: Origins [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/271260]here[/url].
